meta.cleanup_note: Nettoyage manuel: suppression charges_externes en base metier + dedoublonnage produits. Filtre supplémentaire: conservation des factures d'achat uniquement.
meta.source_invoice_ids_note: Jusqu a 3 invoice_id source par article_source depuis invoice_form.

epicerie_multi_client_enrichment_v1.merge_rule: append new article_source not already present (normalized exact)

rules: replace 0 with o only when 0 is adjacent to letters

text_normalization_v2.rule: remove special chars (including % * +), fix OCR 0/O in words, normalize canon + keywords

speedmarket_2023_pdf_import_v1.note: Some PDFs in the 2023 folder have 2024 dates; they were kept because the request targeted the folder contents.

dedupe_article_source_v1.rule: merge rows having identical article_source; keep most complete row and union source_invoice_ids/mots_cles/ape_context

speedmarket_2023_replace_with_older_v1.note: Imported Speedmarket 2023 articles with a confirmed FEC match were replaced by older pre-existing epicerie entries.
